vintage-50s.paraQue: Historias de transformación, testimonios, salud, hogar, comida. Cálido y confiable.
vintage-50s.promptImagen: illustrated like a 1950s American print advertisement: gouache and ink, warm limited palette of tomato red, mustard yellow, dusty teal and cream, crisp confident outlines, subtle offset-print grain, optimistic mid-century look
vintage-50s.promptEscenografia: a decorative frame in 1950s mid-century print style: atomic starbursts, boomerang shapes, halftone ribbons and scalloped edges in tomato red, mustard yellow and cream
vintage-50s.musica: upbeat 1950s lounge swing, brushed drums, upright bass, vibraphone and soft horns, warm and hopeful, instrumental

cine-negro.paraQue: Problemas ocultos, 'lo que nadie te cuenta', misterio, denuncias, antes/después dramático.
cine-negro.promptImagen: 1940s film noir graphic-novel illustration: stark black and white ink, heavy shadows, dramatic side lighting, light stripes from window blinds, a single touch of crimson red, bold brush strokes, grainy print
cine-negro.promptEscenografia: a decorative frame in film noir style: silhouettes of rainy city rooftops, street lamps, fedora hats, curls of smoke and diagonal light stripes in black, charcoal grey and a touch of crimson
cine-negro.musica: dark noir jazz, muted trumpet, walking double bass, soft brushed snare, smoky and suspenseful, instrumental

pizarron.paraQue: Explicar un método, pasos, fórmulas, 'te lo explico fácil', educación y consultoría.
pizarron.promptImagen: hand-drawn chalk illustration: white and pastel yellow, pink and light blue chalk strokes with dusty grainy texture, simple expressive blackboard doodle style
pizarron.promptEscenografia: a decorative frame of chalk doodles: arrows, stars, underlines, simple math symbols, little light bulbs and eraser smudges drawn in white and pastel chalk
pizarron.musica: playful acoustic ukulele and pizzicato strings, light claps and glockenspiel, curious and friendly, instrumental

neon.paraQue: Ofertas, lanzamientos, eventos, vida nocturna, tecnología, energía y urgencia.
neon.promptImagen: glowing neon sign artwork: bright bent glass tubes in hot pink, electric cyan and violet with soft luminous bloom, simple bold line shapes, retro-futuristic night mood
neon.promptEscenografia: a frame made of glowing neon tubes: a pink and cyan double outline with small neon stars, lightning bolts and arrows
neon.musica: synthwave, pulsing analog bass, gated drums, shimmering arpeggios, energetic night drive, instrumental

billete.paraQue: Dinero, ahorro, inversión, precios, ganancias, finanzas, 'lo que te está costando'.
billete.promptImagen: engraved banknote illustration: fine intaglio line engraving with crosshatching and stippling, guilloche linework, monochrome deep green ink with a hint of burgundy, precise currency-portrait craftsmanship
billete.promptEscenografia: an ornate banknote border: guilloche rosettes, laurel garlands, fine engraved wave patterns and corner medallions in deep green and burgundy ink
billete.musica: confident hip-hop instrumental, crisp finger snaps, deep bass, bright piano stabs, ambitious and bold

pop-art.paraQue: Ganchos explosivos, sorpresa, humor, productos juveniles, 'boom' de resultados.
pop-art.promptImagen: 1960s pop-art comic print: thick black outlines, Ben-Day halftone dots, flat bold red, yellow, blue and white, dramatic comic-book expressions, punchy graphic look
pop-art.promptEscenografia: a comic-book frame: explosive starbursts, speed lines, halftone dot fields and jagged burst shapes in red, yellow, blue and black
pop-art.musica: energetic surf rock and garage pop, twangy guitar, handclaps, bouncy drums, fun and bold, instrumental

andino.paraQue: Marcas latinoamericanas, turismo, gastronomía, artesanía, orgullo local, tradición.
andino.promptImagen: flat graphic illustration inspired by Andean woven textiles and pre-Columbian art: stepped geometric shapes, zigzags and diamond motifs in clothing and objects, earthy palette of cochineal red, saffron yellow, deep teal, magenta and undyed wool cream, subtle woven texture
andino.promptEscenografia: a woven Andean textile border: bands of stepped diamonds, zigzags, stylized llamas, condors and sun motifs in cochineal red, saffron, teal and magenta
andino.musica: modern Andean fusion, charango and bamboo flute over a soft electronic beat with bombo drum, warm and uplifting, instrumental

plano.paraQue: Procesos, sistemas, 'cómo funciona', tecnología, construcción, métodos paso a paso.
plano.promptImagen: technical engineering blueprint drawing: thin crisp white construction lines, dimension arrows, measurement ticks and cross-section details, precise orthographic drafting, white linework only
plano.promptEscenografia: a blueprint drawing frame: ruler tick marks, dimension lines, gears, bolts and compass arcs in thin white lines
plano.musica: minimal electronic, precise ticking percussion, clean synth plucks, focused and building momentum, instrumental

sellos-oficina.paraQue: Burocracia, trámites, papeleo, 'rechazado/aprobado', seguros, legal, humor sobre procesos lentos.
sellos-oficina.promptImagen: bureaucratic office illustration: manila folders, rubber stamps, carbon paper and typed forms, flat muted beige and grey tones with vivid red and blue stamp ink, slightly worn photocopy texture, deadpan satirical tone
sellos-oficina.promptEscenografia: a frame of overlapping office paperwork: manila folder tabs, paper clips, staples, round stamp marks, coffee rings, punched holes and carbon copies
sellos-oficina.musica: quirky office bossa nova, muted marimba, light typewriter-like percussion, pizzicato bass, gentle ironic humor, instrumental

mapa-expedicion.paraQue: Viajes, rutas, 'el camino para lograr X', descubrimientos, planes por etapas.
mapa-expedicion.promptImagen: antique expedition map illustration: sepia ink linework with loose watercolor washes, explorer's field-journal sketch, hand-drawn hatching, aged parchment feel
mapa-expedicion.promptEscenografia: an antique map frame: rope border, compass rose, tiny mountains, palm trees, sea waves, a small sailing ship, dotted routes and latitude tick marks in sepia and faded red
mapa-expedicion.musica: adventurous cinematic folk, plucked acoustic guitar, frame drum, soft strings, journey and discovery, instrumental
